mapper.select:
/* RevertTodoMapper.selectList */
SELECT A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, -- 생성일 B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM, -- 업무구분 1 : 수입, 2 : 수출 A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, -- refNo CASE WHEN A.SAVE_FLAG = '00000000000000000000' THEN '' ELSE '저장' END AS SAVE, CASE WHEN A.SAVE_CHG_DTM = '00000000000000000000' THEN '' ELSE 'start' END AS STARTED, A.INPT_MST_SRNO, -- 마스터번호 C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM, -- 프로세스 D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM, -- 액티비티 A.CSNO AS AI_INPT_CSNO, -- 고객번호 A.CUS_KORL_NM AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM, -- 고객명 A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS FC_CUNM, -- 통화 A.XPBY_COL_AM AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM, -- 금액 A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, -- TotalText 심사코드 A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, -- 항목심사 심사코드 A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD, -- SAFEWATCH 심사코드 A.FILT_DTCT_NO, -- DetectionID G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM, -- TotalText 심사코드명 H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM, -- 항목심사 심사코드명 I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM, -- SAFEWATCH 심사코드명 A.PAPS_RE_SCAN_CMPL_YN, -- 재스캔 완료 여부 A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD, -- 액티비티코드 A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, -- 업무구분코드 A.WRR_INFO, -- 주의 코드명 CASE WHEN A.BL IS NULL OR A.IVOC IS NULL THEN 'NO_BLIV' ELSE 'BLIV' END AS BLIV FROM ( -- 마스터테이블 SELECT M.INPT_RCP_DT, M.ACTL_FX_REFNO, M.INPT_MST_SRNO, M.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, M.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, M.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD, M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, M.AI_INPT_PROS_CD, M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD, M.FX_REFNO_SRNO, M.PAPS_RE_SCAN_CMPL_YN, NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS XPBY_COL_AM, NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS CUS_KORL_NM, NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS CSNO, (-- DetectionID SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO -- DetectionID , ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC) AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '120') OR H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO -- 주의 코드명 , (-- 저장 플래그 SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM ( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' ) ) AS SAVE_FLAG
, (--임시저장최종일시 SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM ( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND INPT_MST_SRNO IN (SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '51') ) ) AS SAVE_CHG_DTM , M.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS MST_CHG_DTM --마스터최조정벼변경일시 ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS BL ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '02' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IVOC FROM CSPD001TM M , CSPD201TM E -- 수출테이블 , CSPD202TM I -- 수입테이블
WHERE M.AI_INSPE_ENO = #{userId} AND M.PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL AND M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('80', '90', '150') AND M.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND M.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND M.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND M.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+)
AND M.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
AND M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}
AND M.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
AND M.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
) A, CSPD112TI B, -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 150 = 업무구분코드 CSPD112TI C, -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 280 = 프로세스코드 CSPD112TI D, -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 290 = 액티비티코드 CSPD112TI G, -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 170 = 심사코드, TotalText CSPD112TI H, -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 170 = 심사코드, 항목심사 CSPD112TI I -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 170 = 심사코드, SAFEWATCH WHERE B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '150' -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 150 = 업무구분코드 AND A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) AND C.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '280' -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 280 = 프로세스코드 AND A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD = C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) AND D.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '290' -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 290 = 액티비티코드 AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) AND G.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '170' -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 170 = 심사코드, TotalText AND A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD = G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) AND H.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '170' -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 170 = 심사코드, 항목심사 AND A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD = H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) AND I.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '170' -- 공통코드테이블 그룹코드 : 170 = 심사코드, SAFEWATCH AND A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD = I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+)
AND A.CSNO = #{aiInptCsno}
ORDER BY SAVE
ORDER BY SAVE DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY A.WRR_INFO
ORDER BY A.WRR_INFO DESC
ORDER BY C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD
ORDER BY XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD DESC
ORDER BY XPBY_COL_AM
ORDER BY XPBY_COL_AM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY CUS_KORL_NM
ORDER BY CUS_KORL_NM DESC
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.FILT_DTCT_NO
ORDER BY A.FILT_DTCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO
ORDER BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO DESC
ORDER BY A.SAVE_CHG_DTM DESC , A.MST_CHG_DTM
